items.summary: Recommendation: contain spend and monetization claims this cycle. Reject new implementation, marketing, infrastructure, and affiliate expansion while 10/10 delivery slots are occupied, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all income is in aggregate tracking ID "other" and cannot support site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, or forecast claims. AI usage on 2026-10-01 is $2.2785467 across 16 calls and only 4 instrumented sites; it cannot be compared with the 2026-09-21 revenue window or allocated across the 6 proven outcomes. Monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank, so budget exposure is not calculable. Retain only existing repair and measurement gates; after a slot is released, the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is the lowest-risk learning test. Do not claim revenue or causal lift.
